validation.notes: Root cause: DefaultResourceLoader.reload() in packages/coding-agent/src/core/resource-loader.ts hardcoded `const projectTrusted = false` after the untrusted bootstrap pass, so the caller-supplied resolveProjectTrust callback was never consulted and project resources were always denied. Fix: `const projectTrusted = await options.resolveProjectTrust({ extensionsResult: preTrustExtensions })` before setProjectTrusted, which calls the resolver exactly once, passes it the untrusted bootstrap result, and awaits the asynchronous decision before the subsequent settings reload and package resolution. The regression uses .prale-eval/subject.mjs createTrustSubject to exercise the real reload path: it asserts one resolver call, an untrusted bootstrap view (no project extension) with settings/packages resolved as untrusted at resolution time, no trust grant before the resolver returns, project extension loading after a true decision, and continued denial of project extensions after a false decision. It passes on the repaired source (exit 0) and, when the original `const projectTrusted = false` line was temporarily restored for replay, failed with AssertionError 'trust resolver must be called exactly once' (exit 1). Limitation: the repository's vitest suite was not run because node_modules/dependencies are not installed in this sandbox and installing them was out of scope; no network was used and the standalone regression requires only Node 24.
